name: Basic Electronics Company
verdict: Basic Electronics Co. Ltd. (BASIC / Al-Asasyah) is a family-owned Saudi company owned by founder Mohammad Ahmad Al Arfaj. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: founder/family-owned per the company's own about page; no state stake and no human-rights finding found. Strategic partner of Abha; BASIC wordmark on the lower front of the 2026-27 home shirt.
